ports.editPendingTransaction: transactionId + revision + whitelisted draft fields only
ports.syncTransaction: confirmed results + latest holding revision; stale conflict becomes EXTERNAL_CHANGED; no silent overwrite
ports.managePlan: create/update/pause/resume/delete by stable planId and fundId; dispatch NOT implemented
ports.saveStrategy: NDX100 index only, thresholds+amounts; no fund or BUY execution
ports.readMarket: NDX100 + FX snapshots with source and timestamp
